in_marathi.name: Gaurinath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Golden path, Lord of Gauri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gaurinath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Gaurinath' is derived from Sanskrit language, where 'Gauri' means 'Golden' and 'Nath' means 'Lord'. This name signifies the one who is the Lord of Golden Gauri, who is the epitome of beauty and grace. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often referred to as Gaurinath, the Lord of Gauri, who is the consort of Lord Shiva.
